verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of Runloop's billing model or of per-second metering of sandbox compute. The only cost-related items are adjacent controls: suspend/resume to 'save state and costs' and idle auto-shutdown settings. These reduce spend but do not show that billing is per-second or strictly usage-based. The $50 free-credit trial does not describe billing granularity either.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can pay per second only for the compute a sandbox actually uses
